form:FormGroup.label: Timeout
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long to wait for a response once a request has been sent. 0 means wait indefinitely. Default is 3 minutes.

form:FormGroup.label: Connection Timeout
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long to wait for a new connection to be established, including any TLS negotiation. 0 means wait indefinitely. Default is 3 minutes.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Includes TLS negotiation; 0 waits indefinitely. Default is 3 minutes.

form:FormGroup.label: Connection Request Timeout
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long to wait for a free connection from the connection pool. Default is 3 minutes.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Wait for a free pooled connection. Default is 3 minutes.

form:FormGroup.label: Time To Live
form:FormGroup.helpText: The longest time a pooled connection can stay idle before it is closed. Default is 1 hour.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Idle time before a pooled connection is closed. Default is 1 hour.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether cookies set by a server are kept and sent back to it on later requests. Some endpoints use a cookie to hold a session, e.g. after signing in, so requests to them need cookies. Default is unticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Keeps and sends back server cookies. Default is unticked.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether a redirect response (3xx) is followed. Some endpoints redirect in order to authenticate, so a request that does not follow redirects will see the redirect response itself rather than the resource it was after. Default is ticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Some endpoints redirect to authenticate. Default is ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Max Connections
form:FormGroup.helpText: The maximum number of connections in the pool across all hosts. Default is 1024.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Total across all hosts. Default is 1024.

form:FormGroup.label: Max Connections Per Route
form:FormGroup.helpText: The maximum number of pooled connections to any one host. Default is 1024.

form:FormGroup.label: Keep Alive
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long a connection is kept open for reuse before it is reconnected. 0 closes the connection after every request. Default is 0.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: 0 closes the connection after each request. Default is 0.

form:FormGroup.label: Retries
form:FormGroup.helpText: How many times a failed request is retried. 0 means no retries. Default is 0.

form:FormGroup.label: User Agent
form:FormGroup.helpText: The value sent as the User-Agent header of each request. Leave blank to use the HTTP client's default.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Sent as the User-Agent header. Blank uses the HTTP client's default.

form:FormGroup.label: Validate After Inactivity Period
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long a pooled connection can be idle before it is checked as still usable before reuse. 0 checks it every time. Default is 0.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Idle time before a reused connection is checked. Default is 0.
